# Open Ethics Standard

> A local MCP server that lets an AI coding assistant diagnose harmful practices (dark patterns, privacy traps, billing tricks) in a project, backed by the open Open Ethics Standard catalog. No account or API key required.

- [Agent setup guide](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/agent-setup.md): Install the local stdio MCP, review the chosen scope, and generate an offline report.
- [The standard](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard/blob/main/OPEN-ETHICS-STANDARD.md): Canonical practice definitions.
- [Source](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard): MCP source and contribution guide.
- [Hosted MCP](https://mcp.codebylevel.com/mcp): Optional Streamable HTTP endpoint. It receives submitted findings, so use local stdio for private reviews.
